newsitem.title: PERU: Peru 43-day CDs draw 14.5 pct avg yield at auction.
newsitem.headline: Peru 43-day CDs draw 14.5 pct avg yield at auction.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Tuesday it accepted bids for 43-day Certificates of Deposit (CDs) worth 30.0 million soles at an effective average annual rate of 14.50 percent during a bank auction BCQZ.
The CDs have a November 13 starting date.
The accepted bids also had a minimum and maximum rate of 14.50 percent, the bank said.
At the last CD auction November 7, 28-day CDs drew an average yield of 16.04 perecnt.
At Tuesday's auction, the bank said it received bids on the CDs totalling 73.2 million soles.
The bank had offered 30 million soles worth of CDs.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
